sources.name: OS NGD Buildings Theme
sources.role: buildings theme structure, identifiers and embedded-height scope
verified_facts: The theme contains Building, Building Access Location, Building Line and Building Part feature types.
OSID is the primary identifier; TOID availability varies by feature type.
semantic_limits: Theme membership and embedded height attribution do not establish bare-earth parcel elevation or legal extent.

sources.name: OS NGD Building Features Collection
sources.role: building collection currency, attribution and access contract
verified_facts: The collection provides standalone building features with up-to-daily updates and rich attribution.
Building access locations are separate point features.
semantic_limits: Collection currency and building attribution are not runtime source-byte or terrain-measurement receipts.

sources.name: OS NGD Building Feature Type
sources.role: aggregated building geometry and schema-version contract
verified_facts: A Building geometry consists of adjoining building parts determined to be part of the same building.
Schema and temporal-version metadata must be resolved before comparison.
semantic_limits: An aggregated building footprint is not an HMLR legal extent or a DEM sampling mask.

sources.name: OS NGD Building Part Feature Type
sources.role: building-part geometry, height attribution and version contract
verified_facts: A Building Part is a polygon representing a complete building or an externally identifiable part.
The feature type has multiple live and historic schema versions.
semantic_limits: Building height attribution describes construction, not EA DTM bare-earth max-minus-min.

sources.name: OS NGD Building Line Feature Type
sources.role: building division and overhang line contract
verified_facts: A Building Line can represent a wall between buildings, an internal division or an overhanging edge.
It is a line feature with temporal-filtering constraints.
semantic_limits: A line representation cannot replace a polygon containment mask or terrain sample set.

sources.name: OS NGD Building Access Location
verified_facts: The feature is a point representing pedestrian or vehicle access to a building.
OSID and version metadata accompany the feature.
semantic_limits: An access point is not the building footprint, cadastral extent or terrain extremum.

sources.name: OS NGD Buildings Summary
verified_facts: The summary distinguishes building feature types and collection-level availability.
Building Access Location data has a separate role from polygon building data.
semantic_limits: A collection summary cannot prove candidate-specific geometry, source version or numeric accuracy.

sources.name: OS NGD Building Attribution
sources.role: building attribute provenance and interpretation contract
verified_facts: The page supplements the Building feature page with attribution guidance.
Attribute meaning and provenance must be interpreted according to the documented feature model.
semantic_limits: Attribution presence is not evidence that every value is populated or suitable for terrain calculations.

sources.name: How Building Data Is Created
sources.role: building creation process and source-provenance contract
verified_facts: The page documents processes and sources used to create selected building attributes.
Some attributes can depend on external source processes.
semantic_limits: Creation methodology does not convert building attributes into authoritative bare-earth elevation.

sources.name: Building Part Description Code List
verified_facts: The code list defines description values associated with Building Part features.
Values classify represented building-part types.
semantic_limits: A descriptive class is not geometry accuracy, legal ownership or height confidence.
